prompt.text:
Implement the following API.

File contract: Return strict TypeScript module solution.ts.
Required API: export function dependenciesValid(nodes: string[], edges: Array<[string,string]>): boolean
Behavior: Return true exactly when node names are unique, every directed edge endpoint is declared, and the directed dependency graph is acyclic. Empty input is valid.
Visible example: nodes [parse, build, ship] with parse->build and build->ship is valid; adding ship->parse makes it invalid.

Return only the complete source file; do not include Markdown fences or prose.

Behavior: Return true exactly when node names are unique, every directed edge endpoint is declared, and the directed dependency graph is acyclic. Empty input is valid.

reference.code: export function dependenciesValid(n:string[],e:Array<[string,string]>):boolean{const d=new Map<string,number>();for(const x of n){if(d.has(x))return false;d.set(x,0)}const g=new Map<string,string[]>();for(const[a,b]of e){if(!d.has(a)||!d.has(b))return false;if(!g.has(a))g.set(a,[]);g.get(a)!.push(b);d.set(b,d.get(b)!+1)}const q=[...d].filter(x=>x[1]===0).map(x=>x[0]);let seen=0;while(q.length){const x=q.pop()!;seen++;for(const y of g.get(x)??[]){d.set(y,d.get(y)!-1);if(d.get(y)===0)q.push(y)}}return seen===n.length}
